The problem in FFXIV is that DPS checks are historically tight and the typical approach to raid content is to do as much damage as possible so that you have to do as little of the fight as possible because every interaction shit can go wrong 

So people who ordinarily would not be *required* to do damage do so in order to give the team some padding and security, and then the game naturally developed so that their primary job is something they figure out to do in bursts, and fill every waking moment of time with DPS

It's a bit like working at a Chinese company where you have to do actual work one hour out of your eight hour day and the other seven hours are you doing someone else's work so that the entire company doesn't fucking collapse Saturday when your BRD parsing 99s goes to a better raid team that also does ultimates on the weekends ZANA you PIECE of SHIT
But healers are still the ones that push big HPS, tanks are still multiplicatively more durable than DPS, and DPS... do DPS

And proper healers are the only ones with AoE healing, so even if you did have a DPS who could heal, every other DPS that can't heal is going to die anyway. Off-role healing is a gimmick that is useful in smaller group content where damage is lower or secondary effects are in play that severely adjust the formula.
So would it be more like a Tank/Support hard fills their role, but DPS in windows when they can, while DPS keep DPSing since its a DPS check ultimately?

Also the game is designed so that people are targeted by mechanics based on their roles so you can't always just skip two tanks and two healers; then anything targeted two healers will go uncontrollably, unpredictably wild
